item.title: 7 Best Moments From the 2026 BET Awards You Didn’t See on Television
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our special podcast, I'm your host Druski. Last night, the 2026 BET Awards took over the Peacock Theatre in Los Angeles, and what a night it was! The star-studded event was packed with incredible performances, tributes, and award wins. Let's dive in and break it down."
[Music transitions to a more upbeat tone]
Host: "The night was anchored by amazing tributes to the one and only Ms. Lauryn Hill and the late D'Angelo. Ms. Hill was honored with the Living Legend Icon Award, and her tribute featured a range of stars, including her own children, Selah, YG, and Zion Marley. We saw performances from Doja Cat and Nas, Lizzo and Rapsody, and Common and Queen Latifah, all paying homage to Ms. Hill's legendary music."
[Music transitions to a soulful tone]
Host: "And then there was the tribute to D'Angelo, with his backing band, The Vanguard, reuniting to support an incredible lineup of vocalists, including RAYE, George Clinton, and Ari Lennox. One of the standout performances was Durnad Bernarr's killer rendition of 'S—t, Damn, Motherf—er'."
[Music transitions back to an upbeat tone]
Host: "The awards themselves were also exciting, with Cardi B taking home the Best Female Hip-Hop Artist trophy for the third time. Teyana Taylor and Clipse swept the ceremony with three wins each, including the Icon of the Year Award, which was presented to Teyana by none other than Janet Jackson."
[Music transitions to a celebratory tone]
Host: "And it wasn't just the artists who were honored. Culture-shaping record executive Sylvia Rhone received the Ultimate Icon Award, presented by Kelly Rowland, for her incredible impact on contemporary Black music and the music industry."
[Music transitions to a wrap-up tone]
Host: "That's a wrap on the 2026 BET Awards. It was an unforgettable night, with so many amazing performances, tributes, and award wins. Thanks for tuning in to our special podcast – we'll catch you next time!"
[Outro music plays]
